the syntactic information is not as useful for language modeling as it is for parsing.
generative dependency models do not seem to be as effective as generative phrase-structure models, and the construction order does not seem to matter much for either task.
the syntactic information in dependency trees is less helpful for modeling text than previously thought.

the construction order is not a key factor in the success of neural dependency models.
